native_findings.contract: The graceful Worldgroup logoff callback clears forget-list state, runs the shared MajorMUD leave cleanup, saves the player once, clears the live player, then clears the active session/line slot.

Unexpected hangup performs an initial _save_player, evaluates the configured hangup consequence, runs _check_kill_user and—when still active—the shared leave cleanup, performs the final _save_player, then clears the live player/session slot.

Retained WCCMMUD configuration prompts default hangup punishment to NONE, minimum loss 0%, maximum loss 0%, and maximum items lost 0. Native punishment modes are HIGH=1, MEDIUM=2, LOW=3, NONE=4; HIGH always qualifies, MEDIUM requires autocombat/being attacked, LOW requires PvP combat, NONE never applies the penalty.

_stop_following(leader,-1) scans active users, clears every follower whose leader reference matches the departing leader and removes each from the group; it then calls _remove_from_group on the departing user. No successor election occurs.

_dismiss_users_angels deletes only the native special summon class/owner shape including marker value 37 and matching player owner name. It does not prove generic pet, mercenary, escort, or charm cleanup semantics.
_cleanup_pending_commands walks and deletes the user's pending-command linked chain until the owner pointer is null.

_cmd_quit performs command-stage autocombat/gang-invite exit setup and queues host exit work; the full shared leave cleanup and save/clear ordering belong to the later Worldgroup logoff callback, not the initial QUIT parser branch.
_check_kill_user calls the shared leave cleanup before status termination and before practice-arena or ordinary death item/life/respawn handling.

preserved_boundaries.reason: Leader/death/disconnect departure cleanup is now exact, but leader/default rank, Frontrank slot formula, and special teleport/resurrection/PvP room-spell edges remain unresolved.
Per-session graceful/hangup save ordering is now exact, while the broader Player/Buffer/Btrieve transaction, flush, shutdown and partial-save contract remains unresolved.
Native marker-37 angel dismissal is exact; mercenary/charm/generic companion departure behavior is not inferred from it.
The native decision/defaults are recovered. Reforged stock parity follows retained NONE/0/0/0; nondefault operator configuration is not silently enabled without an explicit configuration owner.
